ncaaf.note: Power rating by opponent-adjusted scoring margin, points per game better than an average team against an average opponent, solved from our own results. Last season carries forward as the preseason prior by how much of its production each team actually returns — from 0.39 for a team keeping 15% of its yards to 0.77 for one keeping 85% — and every result since moves it. Strength of schedule is solved alongside it and travels with each row.. Rated teams average 2.8 game(s) this season, so this is mostly what carried over rather than current form.

excluded.reason: A pick recorded after kickoff is not a prediction and is kept out of the record. It is still listed, flagged, so nothing disappears without saying why.

user_picks.note: Predictions only — no stake, price or balance is published. The model's figure is the one frozen an hour before kickoff, not a rating computed afterwards.

upset_of_the_week.basis: recorded when the week's picks were made: up to 3 underdogs the model rates at least 5 points above the market, biggest gap first, in FBS games involving at least one Power Four team, excluding teams outplayed on EPA in their most recent game
upset_of_the_week.caveat: Editorial, not advice. This is the model's most contrarian call of the week, and disagreement of this kind has historically predicted WORSE results on our graded college samples, not better. Publish it as something to watch and grade afterwards, never as a recommended bet.

game_of_the_week.basis: highest mean rating minus rating gap, among games inside the horizon where both teams are rated and the model is under 85.0% — the best matchup on the board, not the most confident pick
game_of_the_week.caveat: Editorial, not advice. The game is chosen for how close and how strong the two teams are by our own ratings; the model's read on it is reported alongside, not used to select it. It is a live shadow forecast like every other pick here and carries no frozen receipt.

publication.reason: Live shadow forecasts. Not promoted out of shadow status and not frozen pregame, so they carry no official-pick receipt.

lock_policy.rule: The scorecard freezes 60 minutes before kickoff. It stores the newest forecast generated at or before that moment, alongside the market price as it stood then, and is never rewritten afterwards.

versus_market.basis: no-vig consensus as it stood at the lock deadline, not the closing price
